output.reason: The brief ties each claim to evidence I can see (passing repeat, steady QC means, 43 samples agreeing between analyzers, highs split evenly across A and B), and every sign-off item is clear, but it doesn't settle whether the Ward 6 highs come from transport delay or from the renal overflow patients.
